System

Water, swimming and shoreline transitions

Water is a 3D volume with a water surface and reachable shoreline, not a sprite animation state. The player can swim without climbing; fishing access and swimming permissions use related water metadata but different action rules.

Scope and player interaction

Water is a 3D volume with a water surface and reachable shoreline, not a sprite animation state. The player can swim without climbing; fishing access and swimming permissions use related water metadata but different action rules.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase02committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Dry → Wading → Swimming → ExitingWater → InvalidWater → Dead

WBP_HUD observes results from URPGSwimmingComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Swim_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
WaterBodyId: authored stable ID shared with fishing volumes
SurfaceZCm and bottom/collision geometry: authoring data
SwimSpeedCmPerSecond=250; ExitSlopeDegrees<=35 initially
SubmersionThreshold: capsule water-volume condition, not sprite alpha
CanFishWhileSwimming=false initially; underwater combat disabled initially
DrowningEnabled=false initially; no oxygen UI until a deliberate survival rule exists

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGSwimmingComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_HUDLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
EvaluateWaterContact(WaterBodyId, CapsuleState) -> Wading|Swimming|Dry; authoritative movement integration
RequestShoreExit(Direction) -> Grounded|TooSteep|Blocked; standard movement/collision checks
CancelWaterIncompatibleActions(Reason) -> Canceled; combat/gather/fishing owners handle their own cleanup

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Capsule enters a water Physics Volume with water behavior configured; the movement component recognizes Swimming when the actual body conditions are satisfied.
  2. Server chooses movement mode from collision/volume state, never a client-sent IsSwimming truth.
  3. Input applies swimming movement while camera/feet rendering changes cosmetically; temporary art fallback is a labeled common-body pose with a waterline effect.
  4. At shore, collision sweep and walkable-floor result establish grounded movement; do not teleport to a client-selected bank.
  5. Cancel mining, woodcutting and shore-only fishing when authoritative water state invalidates them.
  6. Replicate mode and relevant volume identity; on transfer/reconnect load safe supported spawn coordinates, never inside an unloaded water body.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create a shallow basin, deep volume and two shoreline ramps in L_TerrainLab. The simple prototype can use a configured Physics Volume; a full Water rendering plugin is not a gameplay requirement.
  2. Set water-volume physics flags in the installed Editor and verify CharacterMovement actually enters Swimming. Record the exact settings with a local screenshot before claiming compatibility.
  3. Author BP_WaterRegion with WaterBodyId and surface bounds used by fishing; keep it distinct from the volume responsible for movement mode.
  4. Assign DA_Swim_Default to BP_PlayerCharacter's swimming adapter and expose speed/shore permissions as defaults, not runtime writable UMG fields.
  5. Test low banks, submerged stairs, bridge-over-water and gaps between neighboring volumes. Add a dry safe PlayerStart beside the test area.

Reopen Phase02 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_TerrainLab / Water_Shallow / Water_Deep / ShoreRamp. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Client claims Dry while server capsule is submerged -> server mode wins; shore-only actions reject WrongMode.
Steep vertical bank -> Blocked/TooSteep; no implicit climb.
Volume destroyed or streamed out -> cancel dependent actions and recover to last validated safe position; log InvalidWater.
Swimming art missing -> visible declared fallback; collision/swim functionality remains testable.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Swimming speed 250 cm/s and no drowning are initial proposals. Underwater combat and mounted swimming are not part of the initial implementation.

Show water ID, movement mode, floor result and action cancellation in diagnostics. Provide visual and text water-state cues; avoid requiring audio to notice danger.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
